name: athens-necropolis
note: ADMIN-ONLY. Two wholly fictional Kindred necropoleis. The OLD necropolis under central Athens is sealed and inaccessible; its galleries are drawn ragged and broken because the records are fragments — nothing here is confirmed. The NEW necropolis is a small, recent site above Papagou. Not real. Not for players yet.

New 2026 Entrance
properties.note: Cut in 2026 between the Acropolis and Syngrou-Fix. Bricked over within the year. The only modern way anyone found in — and it is shut again.

properties.name: The Rock Vaults
properties.note: Chambers under the south slope of the Acropolis. Entrance walled; interior known only from one 19th-c. account.

properties.name: The Hypogeum
properties.note: A large space beneath the Areopagus. No plan survives. Estimates of its size disagree by an order of magnitude.

properties.name: The Ossuary Halls
properties.note: Bone-galleries under the old market. Depth unrecorded; the lower levels were never entered.

properties.name: The Lower Halls
properties.note: Referred to only as 'the lower halls'. Whether one room or many is not known.

properties.name: The Black Gate
properties.note: A sealed doorway west of the Pnyx. Beyond it, nothing is recorded. It is said to lead somewhere very large.

properties.name: Kerameikos Shaft
properties.note: Vertical shaft into the necropolis from the cemetery district. Choked with fill.

properties.name: Areopagus Chamber
properties.note: Cut into the rock of the hill. Sealed; contents unknown.

properties.name: Plaka Warren
properties.note: A tangle of small chambers under Plaka and Anafiotika. No two accounts of the layout agree.

properties.name: Syntagma Vault
properties.note: Struck during 19th-c. building works, recorded in a sentence, filled in.

properties.name: Olympieion Gallery
properties.note: Under the Olympian precinct. Flooded to an unknown level.

properties.name: First Cemetery Descent
properties.note: A stair from the modern First Cemetery said to reach the old galleries. The door has no handle on this side.

properties.name: Philopappou Collapse
properties.note: The hill stair came down at an unknown date. Debris not cleared.

properties.name: Passage west — unmapped
properties.note: The western gallery continues past here. It has never been surveyed.

properties.name: Passage north — unmapped
properties.note: The climb toward Lykabettos continues past here into no record at all.

properties.name: Passage east — unmapped
properties.note: Beyond the stadium the gallery goes on. Nobody followed it.

properties.name: Reservoir Head
properties.note: Where the north climb reaches the old reservoir under Lykabettos. Roof down.

properties.name: Technopolis Furnace
properties.note: The old gasworks retorts at Gazi. Cold to the public — but one is said to still draw, and to open on the Kerameikos galleries. Where the necropolis burns what it must.

properties.name: Papagou Gate
properties.note: The way into the new necropolis, in the pine wood above Papagou. Small, kept, watched.

properties.name: Holargos Gate
properties.note: The second way in, on the Cholargos side. Comes up in a quiet street off the avenue.

properties.name: Gaming Room
properties.note: Off the Holargos branch — screens, seats, a fridge. Somewhere for the young ones to be.

properties.name: Net Room
properties.note: The far end of the branch: patch panels and a line spliced off the Ministry's fibre.

properties.name: Giannakis Clubhouse
properties.note: Μάστορας Μάστορης Μαστορεύω Μαστορεύουν Μαστορεύει

properties.name: The Hall
properties.note: The central vaulted hall. Niches on every wall, most still empty.

properties.name: The West Cells
properties.note: Private cells off the west side of the hall.

properties.name: The North Cells
properties.note: A deeper string of cells, colder, quieter.

properties.name: The Sanctum
properties.note: The inner vault behind the hall. One occupant, and the courtesy of a locked door.

properties.name: New Ossuary
properties.note: A small ossuary, barely used.

properties.name: The Long Gallery
properties.note: A straight run of cut stone the length of Cholargos, tying the ossuary to the western junction.

properties.name: Cholargos Junction
properties.note: Where the long gallery splits — up the bolt-hole, or on toward the Ministry.

properties.name: The Bolt-Hole
properties.note: A second way out, up into Cholargos. Known to few.

properties.name: Ministry Undercroft
properties.note: A low vaulted space under the grounds of the Ministry of National Defence.

properties.name: Server Room
properties.note: A cooled room of racks directly beneath the Υπουργείο Εθνικής Άμυνας. The necropolis draws its power — and its lines — from here.
